snippet.title: Antioma — Story Trailer | Steam
snippet.description:
Links to Steam page, demo and socials are in the first comment.

The trailer delves deeper into Kiddo’s story. On his seventh birthday, his mommy didn’t come to visit him — instead, he encountered the Shadow, who urged him to embark on a journey. In his adventure, Kiddo will attempt to escape the hospital, finally seeing the world beyond its walls and searching for his mother. The demo is out now!

About the game:
Dive into a touching story. The little boy Kiddo has spent most of his life in the hospital. Little does he know what a complicated and fascinating world lies concealed beyond the hospital walls.

Today, on Kiddo's birthday, his mom wasn't around. Instead of her, the boy met Shadow, who inspired him to escape from a hospital and search for his mom.

Solve puzzles, hide and run from enemies, make friends, and help the boy get home.

Real adventures lie in wait for Kiddo! Now his fate is in your hands…

Music and VA directing – Команда Шаттла 311-Х
Sound design – Valerii Mater

Voice actors:
Kiddo, Shadow, Sunshine - Zarina Zariko Kudashova
Stormy - Ekaterina Vdovik
Michael - Cougar MacDowall

Used sound:
